title: Cosmic Farm Landscape
description: A surreal night landscape depicts a misty rural farm with red barns, scattered trees, and wooden fences under a dramatic purple nebula-filled sky. A large dark celestial body and glowing stars dominate the cosmic heavens above the foggy green and yellow fields.
prompt: A surreal night landscape of a rural farm with red barns, wooden fences and scattered trees standing in misty green and yellow fields, dramatic purple and violet nebula swirling across the starry sky with a large dark celestial body and bright stars, atmospheric fog, painterly style with visible brushstrokes
